title: Bocchi
description: Show a cute anime girl sprite on the glasses' 576x288 monochrome display. Draw her in pixel-art style: big eyes, long hair, a simple outfit, centered on screen. Add a small idle animation like blinking and a gentle bob. Tapping switches between a few expressions (happy, wink, surprised).
prompts: Show a cute anime girl sprite on the glasses' 576x288 monochrome display. Draw her in pixel-art style: big eyes, long hair, a simple outfit, centered on screen. Add a small idle animation like blinking and a gentle bob. Tapping switches between a few expressions (happy, wink, surprised).

Change the character to Hitori "Bocchi" Gotoh from Bocchi the Rock. Give her long hair down past her shoulders with bangs over her eyes, two cube-shaped hair clips on one side, a baggy track jacket, and a guitar held in front of her. Make the expressions fit her: shy and nervous, anxious and sweating, a melting or glitching panic face, and a rare happy smile. Keep the blink and bob idle animation and tap to cycle expressions.
